title: Fairness in federated medical imaging: a systematic review through the dual fairness lens
title_zh: 联邦医学影像中的公平性：双重公平视角下的系统综述
authors: Pengyang Yu, Zhongping Dong, Sahraoui Dhelim, Chun-Mei Feng, and M. Tahar Kechadi.

description.en: A systematic review that studies collaboration fairness across institutions and group fairness across patient populations as two connected dimensions of fairness in federated medical imaging.
description.zh: 一篇系统综述，将联邦医学影像中的机构协作公平与患者群体公平作为相互关联的两个公平维度进行研究。

title: MedLiteNet: Lightweight Hybrid Medical Image Segmentation Model for the Medical Internet of Things (MIoT)
title_zh: MedLiteNet：面向医疗物联网的轻量化混合医学图像分割模型
authors: Pengyang Yu, Haoquan Wang, Gerard Marks, Tahar Kechadi, Laurence T. Yang, Sahraoui Dhelim, and Nyothiri Aung.
journal: IEEE Journal of Selected Areas in Sensors

description.en: A lightweight hybrid CNN–Transformer model for medical image segmentation, representing my earlier work in efficient and deployable medical AI.
description.zh: 面向医学图像分割的轻量化 CNN–Transformer 混合模型，代表我在高效和可部署医学人工智能方面的早期研究。

title: HD-Cal: Few-Shot Reliability Estimation for Cross-Domain Hallucination Heterogeneity in Chest X-Ray Vision-Language Models

subtitle.en: Medical vision-language models · reliability audit · cross-domain evaluation
subtitle.zh: 医学视觉语言模型 · 可靠性审计 · 跨域评估

description.en: A deployment-oriented reliability audit that examines how hallucination and error behaviour varies across chest X-ray domains and findings, and estimates localized reliability with few-shot target-domain information.
description.zh: 面向部署的可靠性审计研究，考察胸部 X 光视觉语言模型的幻觉和错误行为如何随数据域与疾病征象变化，并利用少量目标域信息估计局部可靠性。

keywords: HD-Cal chest X-ray vision language hallucination reliability

title.zh: 上下文调整的公平拒答

subtitle.zh: 可靠性与公平性桥接 · 后续方法研究

description.en: A future direction for separating finding difficulty from demographic under-service, so that deployment-time deferral can respond to genuine unreliability without shifting burden unfairly across groups.
description.zh: 后续方向之一：区分疾病征象本身的难度与对特定群体的服务不足，使部署阶段的拒答策略能够针对真实不可靠性，同时避免将负担不公平地转移给不同群体。
